body: BASISID IMPLEMENTATION HUNK for bd-01M158ACR8F9X3BA3HG7CVRKZ6, reserved rv-01M162R9CFBFVK2E5RZ33F27G9 on the seven announced feature/codec paths. Contract: BasisId is an opaque Checksum over actual TargetFamily plus ordered FeatureTargetKey parts using unambiguous content-address framing; same family/order deterministic, permutation different, empty bases retain explicit family, mixed/mismatched families reject. FeatureDerivation.derivationId and no-basis outputSpaceId remain byte-stable; outputSpaceId(BasisId) adds the basis digest. NarrativeBasis exposes its trusted id. Windowed.overBasis, Aggregate.overBasis, and Aggregate.overTargets stamp both basis-bearing space id and TrackProvenance.basisId; surface Windowed stays None. For empty arbitrary overTargets, a family-explicit overload preserves identity; the inference overload rejects empty rather than inventing a family. FeatureTrack validation/codec reject a basis id whose derived space id does not match, and old provenance JSON without basisId remains None/canonical unchanged. Evidence planned per computational-test skill: pinned cross-platform BasisId golden; deterministic + reorder/metamorphic + different-family empty + mixed-family adversarial laws; public producer same-recipe/different-basis collision regression; DerivationGraph admits both; codec Some/None round trips and mismatch rejection; mutation removing basis from the production space id must turn the collision test red. ADR obligations 1-5 are inapplicable by name: this is identity/provenance, not a distribution/count/threshold/trial/re-atomized estimand. Obligation 6 applies and is load-bearing. Focused gate features+codec JVM/JS/Native, laws where relevant, scalafmt, then compileAll/testAll at frozen SHA.
